testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.persistence.WorkflowRestartRecoveryTests

testcase.name: two processes sweeping one database never both take the same run()
a WAIT timer survives the restart and fires once()
a retry in backoff survives the restart and is attempted after its delay with the attempt count kept()
finished runs stay finished and are never executed again by a new process()
a step whose dead owner still holds a valid lease is left alone, and is taken over as a new attempt once the lease ran out (C4 H-3)()
a step that was RUNNING when its worker died is retried by the next process as a new attempt of the same idempotency key()
a compensation that was interrupted resumes after a restart and does not repeat a compensation that already ran()
a PENDING run that never got its job is started by the next process()
a run whose job was lost with the process is picked up by the next process and finishes without repeating a finished step()
an ambiguous write stays unknown after a restart, is never retried and is never compensated()
